para: lists, variety, one after another, each of them
ficha: 3-7 vertical 9:16 photo cards in a reflective 3D coverflow under a light beam; each slides to center on its word; the last punches forward on the golpe.

para: the hidden one, the secret, the one that matters, the trick
ficha: a hand of photo cards fans open with one face-down card in front; on the golpe it rises, flips and reveals photo 1.

para: message, alert, app, call, scam, online, phone
ficha: 3D phone with the photo on screen; on the golpe a notification drops and bursts out of the glass, huge, with spam copies behind.

para: a spoken amount, price, count, age, year
ficha: steel housing with mechanical drums over a dark photo; they roll and lock one by one, the last exactly on the golpe. cifra must be spoken.

para: caught, watching, proof, thief, someone saw it
ficha: wall of CCTV monitors; on the golpe the camera dives into the main screen and a red reticle locks on the subject with the word tag.

para: A versus B, cheap vs expensive, one wins, one fails
ficha: two neon photo monoliths face to face, spark between; on the golpe the loser flickers off and falls back. lines: lead A, lead B, golpe. var = who loses.

para: a strong statement, warning, the sentence to remember
ficha: photo darkens word by word as giant type appears; on the golpe a marker stroke slashes across and the word flips color inside it.

para: a concrete image plus its one key word, statement, the ground truth
ficha: full-bleed photo tips back on the golpe and becomes the floor; the word rises on it as a solid extruded monolith with reflection and light behind.

para: a place or image plus its key word, the moment it clicks, open, closed, now
ficha: darkened photo with the lead in neon; on the golpe a neon sign drops on cables, swings, flickers on and its light reveals the scene.

para: cycle, again and again, every month, vicious circle, routine
ficha: 3-5 photos orbit a glowing neon ring in perspective, each lighting on arrival; on the golpe the loop spins a full turn around the word.
